_purpose: Tier 1 healthcare/program-integrity seed sources for MarketPulse v4. Used by generate-tactical-brief-background.js to pre-seed citations whenever a topic intersects CMS, medical review, program integrity, prior authorization, VA community care, MHS readiness, telehealth, hospice, home health, DMEPOS, or Medicaid. The seed pack guarantees the v4 audit reaches its ≥40% Tier 1 share and ≥25 source fetches without depending on Perplexity surfacing the right .gov URLs.
_provenance: Seeded from the verified Colleen Rooney / FHAS remediation pack (2026-05-15). See data/marketpulse-v4-source-packs/colleen-rooney-fhas-2026-05-15.md for the audit trail.
_first_used: 2026-05-15 — Colleen Rooney remediated delivery, score 95/100, audit 18/18.
